name: trust_check
description: Get the trust score and reputation data for any ERC-8004 agent before transacting. Returns composite score (0-100), trust tier, 10-signal breakdown, risk flags, and recommendation. Covers 113,000+ agents across 21 EVM chains including Base, Ethereum, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Optimism, and more.

agent_id.description: The ERC-8004 token ID of the agent to evaluate

chain.description: Optional: source chain to scope the evaluation (e.g. base, ethereum, avalanche). Omit for cross-chain.
